svg.text: People, school membership and controlled access
Conceptual relationships • Students, parents, teachers, administrators and operational teams • 11 October 2026
THREE FOUNDATIONS — NOT A ROLL-NUMBER-CENTRED SYSTEM
Every person and record has its own unique ID
One user can belong to more than one school
One membership can hold multiple roles
Roll number belongs to enrollment: school + academic year + class/section.
The same roll number may exist in another class or school. Search can use roll, admission ID, name or another permitted reference.
ARROWS: 1 : N runs from one to many (zero or more). Repeated entity names refer to the same records.
School-owned records are isolated by school. A person record can exist without a login account.
ACCESS DECISION — CHECKED FOR EVERY REQUEST
Verified account + active school membership + permitted action + allowed record scope
Teacher: assigned classes / subjects • Parent: linked children • Student: own records
Administrator: configured school scope • Finance / library / transport staff: their permitted module actions
One person can be a teacher and parent. Each role grant has its own scope; those scopes are not combined blindly.
SHARED ACROSS MODULES: audit history • school settings • compliance • approvals • notifications • file access
Proposed conceptual model, not an implemented database. Scope targets and profile references require concrete foreign keys in the detailed schema.
Many-to-many links use assignment records. Optionality, uniqueness rules and advanced workflows are refined before implementation.
